name: switch_refused_telemetry_enabled
reason: the operator's value was refused and restored to the default, with a recorded violation
detail: `config print --json` reports runtime.telemetry.enabled=false after the environment layer set it true, and state/config-violations.json names [runtime.telemetry.enabled]. This switch REFUSES rather than disables: there is no production reader to turn off (internal/config/migration.go's gate table), so nothing stops — the value never takes effect at all. Not duplicated here: internal/config/validate_test.go pins the refusal itself and test/security's posture_telemetry_is_refused pins telemetry end to end
